query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '首席独立董事'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有普通独立董事名单；仅有董事会独立性比例；董事长与CEO分离但无首席独董；仅有ESG委员会主席；区分：首席独立董事关注独董领导与对董事长制衡；ESG监督委员会关注可持续发展议题监督，二者职位与职能不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: During the Reporting Year, the Group conducted a materiality review to understand the sustainability issues of concern to stakeholders. This not only helps the Group further understand its operation situation, but also guides the Group to formulate proactive and targeted implementation plans. The materiality review adopted a combination of qualitative and quantitative assessments to identify the latest issues related to sustainable development trends in addition to existing material issues. The Group identified and defined twenty-one sustainability issues and megatrends related to the real estate industry, covering environmental protection, employment and labour practices, operating practices, community and innovation. Stakeholders from different business sectors were invited to interviews to understand their views on issues and establish sustainability strategies. Besides, through questionnaire surveys, Board members and employees were invited to rank various issues according to their perceived importance to the business and stakeholders. Based on the opinions of different parties, the following seven important sustainable development issues of the Group were sorted out and approved by the Board and the Executive Committee.

[Content]
During the Reporting Year, the Group conducted a materiality review to understand the sustainability issues of concern to stakeholders. This not only helps the Group further understand its operation situation, but also guides the Group to formulate proactive and targeted implementation plans. The materiality review adopted a combination of qualitative and quantitative assessments to identify the latest issues related to sustainable development trends in addition to existing material issues. The Group identified and defined twenty-one sustainability issues and megatrends related to the real estate industry, covering environmental protection, employment and labour practices, operating practices, community and innovation. Stakeholders from different business sectors were invited to interviews to understand their views on issues and establish sustainability strategies. Besides, through questionnaire surveys, Board members and employees were invited to rank various issues according to their perceived importance to the business and stakeholders. Based on the opinions of different parties, the following seven important sustainable development issues of the Group were sorted out and approved by the Board and the Executive Committee.

results.text: The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development has set a target for the construction industry in China that by 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be built as green buildings, the efficiency of building energy use will be steadily improved, forming a green, low-carbon and recycling approach to construction development. During the Reporting Year, the Group actively expanded into the field of green and intelligent buildings, including the development of universal application of ultra-low energy buildings. The Group's Hohhot Glorioushire Project in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is the first large-scale demonstration project of ultra-low energy clusters in the severe cold region of Mainland China. It adopts passive technology to significantly reduce the heating and cooling needs of the building, improve the efficiency of energy equipment and systems, and bring an energy-saving and healthy living environment to the community.

The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development has set a target for the construction industry in China that by 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be built as green buildings, the efficiency of building energy use will be steadily improved, forming a green, low-carbon and recycling approach to construction development. During the Reporting Year, the Group actively expanded into the field of green and intelligent buildings, including the development of universal application of ultra-low energy buildings. The Group's Hohhot Glorioushire Project in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is the first large-scale demonstration project of ultra-low energy clusters in the severe cold region of Mainland China. It adopts passive technology to significantly reduce the heating and cooling needs of the building, improve the efficiency of energy equipment and systems, and bring an energy-saving and healthy living environment to the community.
